setup: Toes on sliders or a towel
Brace abs and squeeze your glutes
execution: Push your body back past your elbows
Keep a straight line, hips level
Pull back until shoulders are over elbows
Only go as far as you can stay flat

notes: Range is the dial: reaching further back is harder. Stop each rep before your lower back starts to arch.
Use a smooth floor and proper sliders or a towel so the feet glide evenly.
If pain lingers or comes back, stop this exercise and get it checked by a physio or doctor.
stopIf: Pain that changes how you move
